notes: Explicit user authorization covers two-dataset source teacher guidance. Same SharedTwoPriorGain network/loss/inference and physical action; per-dataset contracted adapters, parents, teacher and independently trained weights.

For source U simulated clean/received pair, freeze teacher and parents. Optimize KL(softmax(F(clean)) || softmax(F(output))) + 0.2 normalized IQ MSE(output,clean) + 1.5 normalized MSE(output(clean),real_gain(clean)). Zero-output correction initially equals real-gain expert.

LoRa forward uses the exact scipy-based original W24 aperture and original default head; backward substitutes the existing differentiable WideTracker aperture gradient via exact-forward straight-through estimator. First step independently verifies finite nonzero teacher-loss gradient into gain network; disclose this surrogate, do not claim exact derivative.

Teachers and experts frozen; no U TX, source V, target IQ/truth/statistics or cross-dataset checkpoint. Teacher examples 8000 LoRa / 48000 WiSig plus teacher-input gradient cost and source teacher/parent historical training costs.
